interpretation_ko: 튼튼한 건강과 재산이 쌓일 조짐이며 농부와 그 집 여인들에게는 활기찬 일이 많을 조짐
interpretation_en: augurs robust health and the accumulation of wealth. Much activity is indicated for farmers and their women folks

cite.original: Dreaming of eating peas, augurs robust health and the accumulation of wealth. Much activity is indicated for farmers and their women folks.
cite.translation_ko: 완두콩을 먹는 꿈은, 튼튼한 건강과 재산이 쌓일 조짐이며 농부와 그 집 여인들에게는 활기찬 일이 많을 조짐이다

cite.original: To see them growing, denotes fortunate enterprises.
cite.translation_ko: 자라는 완두콩을 보는 꿈은, 사업이 잘 풀릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 품은 바람이 튼튼한 바탕 위에 있어 이루어질 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that your hopes are well grounded and they will be realized

cite.original: To plant them, denotes that your hopes are well grounded and they will be realized.
cite.translation_ko: 완두콩을 심는 꿈은, 품은 바람이 튼튼한 바탕 위에 있어 이루어질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 계획이 좋게 마무리되어 애쓴 결실을 누릴 조짐
interpretation_en: signifies that your plans will culminate in good and you will enjoy the fruits of your labors

cite.original: To gather them, signifies that your plans will culminate in good and you will enjoy the fruits of your labors.
cite.translation_ko: 완두콩을 거두는 꿈은, 계획이 좋게 마무리되어 애쓴 결실을 누릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 가장 밝던 희망이 한동안 불확실함에 갇히지만 끝내 운수가 풀어줄 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that your brightest hopes will be enthralled in uncertainties for a short season, but they will finally be released by fortune

cite.original: To dream of canned peas, denotes that your brightest hopes will be enthralled in uncertainties for a short season, but they will finally be released by fortune.
cite.translation_ko: 통조림 완두콩 꿈은, 가장 밝던 희망이 한동안 불확실함에 갇히지만 끝내 운수가 풀어줄 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you are overtaxing your health

cite.original: To see dried peas, denotes that you are overtaxing your health.
cite.translation_ko: 마른 완두콩을 보는 꿈은, 건강을 무리하게 쓰고 있다는 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 큰 성공 뒤에 즐거움이나 재산이 조금 줄어들 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that you will, after much success, suffer a slight decrease in pleasure or wealth

cite.original: To eat dried peas, foretells that you will, after much success, suffer a slight decrease in pleasure or wealth.
cite.translation_ko: 마른 완두콩을 먹는 꿈은, 큰 성공 뒤에 즐거움이나 재산이 조금 줄어들 조짐이다
